## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization (10/2)

## Structure and components

- [statement] Partial pushdown is a separately described optimization: Data Federation tries to execute eligible stages such as $match in Atlas and returns their results to the federated layer for subsequent stages. It is not a promise that every pipeline executes wholly in Atlas. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization

## How it works

- [statement] The single-collection proxy optimization is unavailable when the queried virtual collection maps to multiple Atlas collections; one Atlas cluster alone is not the documented eligibility condition. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization
- [statement] The proxy optimization is unavailable when the queried virtual collection maps to multiple Atlas collections, even if those collections belong to the same Atlas store. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Object-store partition pruning selects files using query parameters and configured partition attributes. This file-selection mechanism differs from forwarding a query to a single Atlas collection. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/admin/optimize-query-performance.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md
- [statement] In Stack Overflow comments, a user reported a 30+ second response through Atlas Data Federation versus at most one second when querying the source directly. Another participant listed query shape, network or topology differences, and a bug as possible contributors; the exchange does not establish which cause applied. (low confidence) — https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/answers/73250408/comments?site=stackoverflow&filter=withbody · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A Data Federation collection mapped to only one Atlas collection acts as a proxy: it forwards the query to Atlas without scanning data into its virtual collection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization
- [statement] MongoDB describes the proxy path as improving performance and reducing cost, but its explanation supplies no speedup factor, cost percentage, or zero-charge guarantee. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization
- [statement] The proxy path avoids scanning data into the virtual collection for query processing; MongoDB describes improved performance and reduced cost without quantifying either benefit. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization
- [statement] MongoDB's configuration example places foo and barbaz in one federated instance: foo has one Atlas collection mapping and receives proxy optimization; barbaz has two mappings and does not. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization
- [statement] The documented mechanisms differ: single-collection proxying avoids virtual-collection scanning, whereas object-store partition pruning selects files using query parameters. The latter does not establish proxy eligibility. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: Atlas Data Federation single-collection proxy optimization · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md
